review.brief_reason: Let S = sum_{i=1..5}(xi-3)^2. Since S >= 0 for all real inputs, the denominator 5+S satisfies 5+S >= 5, so |5+S| > 0.001 is always true and the np.where fallback branch (1.0) is unreachable; the denominator can never be zero. The original therefore reduces exactly to np.divide(10, 5+S), which is identical to the proposed 10/(S+5) — addition commutes (bitwise in IEEE-754 as well) and np.divide and '/' are the same division operation. Variables x1..x5 keep identical positions and roles, both expressions are defined on all of R^5, and spot checks (e.g., all xi=3 gives 2.0; x1=4, rest 3 gives 10/6) match.
